validation_gates.determination: Case determination matches the hidden true-positive or false-positive outcome
validation_gates.incident_relevance: Case incident relevance matches the hidden related or unrelated outcome
validation_gates.exact_object: Investigation queried only the case's exact evidence object with DuckDB
validation_gates.case_evidence: Closed case records both decision tags and cites a stored anchor event_ref returned by the exact-object query
validation_gates.evidence_support: The cited case-scoped evidence supports both the final determination and incident-relevance conclusion

enrichment_validation_gates.urlscan: Applicable IOC was successfully enriched using a read-only URLscan search or result lookup
enrichment_validation_gates.virustotal: Applicable IOC was successfully enriched using the matching VirusTotal lookup
